Thank you for reporting a problem! The bug report zip lets us see exactly what you saw:

3. Pick the capture and click "Save bug report (.zip)". The zip is saved in your Downloads folder.
4. Drag that zip into this issue (below). GitHub accepts attachments up to 25 MB; if it is bigger, share it with a
   file sharing service and paste the link.
